purpose: Perform the final controlled review of a property case file before an answer is published as verified, limited, partial or indeterminate.
verified_answer_requirements: procedure and authority established where requested
deadline established or expressly not applicable
limitation_rules: A non-material limitation may coexist with VERIFIED_WITH_LIMITATIONS.
A material unresolved dependency cannot be hidden inside a limitation.
A missing property match blocks a property-specific verified answer.
A missing historical date match blocks a historical verified answer.
An unresolved material legal proposition blocks a definitive legal conclusion.
An unresolved material conflict blocks a definitive conclusion.
An unresolved deadline cannot be represented as a calculated deadline.
hard_stops: Never convert a failed gate into a pass because the answer sounds plausible.
Never use confidence language to conceal a failed material gate.
Never publish a definitive answer with an incomplete trace or audit trail.
Never treat review completion as proof of the underlying facts; it verifies that the publication requirements were met.
